# Cyberware
## Diagnostics
1. Place the patient in [color=#58e6d9]MedicalScanner[/color]. 2. Open [color=#58e6d9]computerBodyScanner[/color]. 3. Open the [color=#58e6d9]Cyberware[/color] tab. 4. Check the slot, integrity, power, heat, EMP lockout, neural link, and functionality.
## Internal modules
- [color=#58e6d9]Neural link Mk.1[/color]: physical item NCImplantNeuralLinkMk1; target Head; slot NCSlotNeuralCore. - [color=#58e6d9]Circulatory assist pump Mk.1[/color]: physical item NCImplantCirculatoryAssistMk1; target Chest; slot NCSlotThoracicSupport.
### Installing an internal module
1. Take the module in the off hand or place it nearby. 2. Select Head for the neural link or Chest for the circulatory assist pump. 3. Perform: Cautery → Scalpel → Hemostat → Retractor → Multitool → Retractor → MedicatedSuture. 4. Confirm the module in the Cyberware tab of the full scanner.
### Removing an internal module
1. Select Head or Chest with an installed module. 2. Perform: Cautery → Scalpel → Hemostat → Retractor → Multitool → Retractor → MedicatedSuture. 3. The removed module becomes a physical item.
## Mechanical replacements
- [color=#58e6d9]Industrial cyberarm[/color]: NCOrganHumanCyberArmLeft or NCOrganHumanCyberArmRight; replaces the matching arm. - [color=#58e6d9]Cyberoptics Mk.1[/color]: NCOrganHumanCyberEyes; replaces the eyes. - [color=#58e6d9]Cyberheart Mk.1[/color]: NCOrganHumanCyberHeart; replaces the heart.
### Installing a cyberarm
1. Select the matching arm. 2. Remove the old limb using the [color=#58e6d9]Limb amputation[/color] operation. 3. Take the matching left or right cyberarm, or place it nearby. 4. On the empty category, perform [color=#58e6d9]Limb reattachment[/color]: Cautery → Scalpel → Hemostat → Retractor → Scalpel → MedicatedSuture → Retractor → MedicatedSuture → MedicatedSuture.
### Installing cyberoptics
1. Select Head. 2. Perform [color=#58e6d9]Eye removal[/color]. 3. Place NCOrganHumanCyberEyes in hand or nearby. 4. Perform [color=#58e6d9]Eye transplantation[/color]: Cautery → Scalpel → Hemostat → Retractor → Scalpel → MedicatedSuture → Retractor → MedicatedSuture → MedicatedSuture.
### Installing a cyberheart
1. Select Chest. 2. Perform [color=#58e6d9]Internal organ removal — heart[/color]. 3. Place NCOrganHumanCyberHeart in hand or nearby. 4. Perform [color=#58e6d9]Internal organ transplantation — heart[/color]: Cautery → Scalpel → Hemostat → Retractor → Scalpel → MedicatedSuture → Retractor → MedicatedSuture → MedicatedSuture.
After attachment, the mechanical part occupies the normal category in the living organ graph and receives the linked neural calibration.
## Maintenance
- Cyberware coolant agent distributes across compatible modules with cooling deficits and reduces heat. - Service repair restores only the parameters defined by the repair item profile. - Mechanical trauma reduces cyber-part integrity and function without creating an organic wound. - EMP temporarily disables the module and can damage the neural interface.
